TestApplicationController::test_remote_c.reason: Deliberately not ported (audit A04-46, A17-25): OpenWhisper's client reserves a recording on the host (recording_begin/recording_end) and transcription.py prepare_host_update refuses during local work only to serve the host's update hold, whose one caller is services/omarchy_controls.py (the Linux Omarchy desktop); the Windows product never asks a host to hold an update. FioriVoce's dictation engine therefore does not advertise recording_activity (tests/remote_host/test_runtime_links.cpp 'the dictation engine does not advertise recording reservations'), and the host half (SpeechHost::prepare_update with OpenWhisper clients' reservations) stays and is tested.
